title: Sets of equiangular lines in dimension $18$ constructed from $A_5^3 \oplus A_1^4$
summary: In 2023, Greaves, Syatriadi, and Yatsyna found a set of $57$ equiangular lines in $\mathbb{R}^{18}$, breaking the previous record. In 2025, Lin, Munemasa, Taniguchi, and Yoshino constructed a large number of sets of $57$ equiangular lines in $\mathbb{R}^{18}$ as affine equiangular sets in an integral overlattice of $A_9^2 \oplus A_1$. In this paper, we construct further sets of $57$ equiangular lines in $\mathbb{R}^{18}$ from Latin squares of order $6$ and Pasch configurations, realized as affine equiangular sets in an integral overlattice of $A_5^3 \oplus A_1^4$. Unlike the previously known examples, these sets are not strongly maximal. Moreover, some of them have only five distinct Seidel eigenvalues, fewer than any previously known examples.

AI.tldr: 本文从 6 阶 Latin 方阵和 Pasch 构型构造了 $\mathbb{R}^{18}$ 中新的 57 线 equiangular lines 集合，某些构造仅有 5 个不同的 Seidel 特征值。
AI.motivation: 在给定维度中寻找最大数量的 equiangular lines 是几何和组合数学中的经典问题。2023 年在 $\mathbb{R}^{18}$ 中达到了 57 条线的记录，但此后构造的新例子有限。
AI.method: 利用 6 阶 Latin squares 和 Pasch configurations，在 $A_5^3 \oplus A_1^4$ 的整 overlattice 中实现为 affine equiangular sets。
AI.result: 构造了 $\mathbb{R}^{18}$ 中更多 57 线 equiangular lines 集合。与之前已知的例子不同，这些集合不是 strongly maximal 的，且其中一些仅有 5 个不同的 Seidel 特征值（此前已知的最少数量更少）。
AI.conclusion: 丰富了 $\mathbb{R}^{18}$ 中 equiangular lines 的构造，并展示了更低的 Seidel 特征值多样性，为相关问题提供了新的视角。
AI.future_work: 是否在 $\mathbb{R}^{18}$ 中存在超过 57 条 equiangular lines？在更高维度或不同 Seidel 特征值约束下做系统搜索。

title: Finite free convolution via reproducing kernels and squarefree algebras
summary: We give a structural account of the finite free convolutions of Marcus, Spielman, and Srivastava in terms of reproducing kernel inner products on polynomial spaces and a multilinear model over the squarefree algebra. In this model, additive convolution becomes algebra multiplication, and the nilpotent logarithm linearizes it, recovering the finite free cumulants of Arizmendi and Perales. This perspective leads to a class $\mathcal{LC}_n$ of multilinear polynomials characterized by nonpositivity of higher-order cumulants, closed under additive convolution and satisfying several key permanence properties associated with negatively dependent measures. We show that every graph Laplacian pencil belongs to this class, with higher-order cumulants given by Hamiltonian cycle counts in induced subgraphs.

AI.tldr: 本文用 reproducing kernel 内积和 squarefree 代数上的多重线性模型给出了 Marcus-Spielman-Srivastava 有限自由卷积的结构性阐述，并引入一个由高阶累积量非正性刻画的多重线性多项式类 $\mathcal{LC}_n$。
AI.motivation: 有限自由卷积（finite free convolution）是自由概率论在多项式根上的类比，由 Marcus, Spielman 和 Srivastava 引入并在谱图论和组合学中有重要应用。但对其结构性的理解仍不充分。
AI.method: 利用多项式空间上的 reproducing kernel 内积和 squarefree 代数上的多重线性模型：加法卷积变为代数乘法，nilpotent logarithm 线性化后恢复 Arizmendi-Perales 的有限自由累积量。
AI.result: 引入类 $\mathcal{LC}_n$：由高阶累积量非正性刻画，在加法卷积下封闭，满足与负相关测度相关的若干关键 permanence 性质。证明每个 graph Laplacian pencil 属于此类，其高阶累积量由诱导子图的 Hamilton 圈计数给出。
AI.conclusion: 为有限自由卷积提供了一种新的结构性理解，将谱图论（Laplacian pencil）与自由概率论通过累积量联系起来。Hamilton 圈作为累积量的组合解释尤为有趣。
AI.future_work: 探索 $\mathcal{LC}_n$ 类在多项式优化、随机矩阵理论中的应用；研究其他组合不变量与高阶累积量的关系。

title: Balanced Sperner families via the topological Tverberg theorem
summary: For every prime power \(r\ge 2\), we show that any Sperner family \(\mathcal F\subseteq 2^{[n]}\) with \(|\mathcal F|\ge (r-1)n+1\) contains \(r\) pairwise disjoint nonempty subfamilies whose unions are all equal and whose intersections are all equal. For \(r=2\), this confirms a conjecture of Hegedüs, with the sharp threshold \(n+1\). In this purely combinatorial problem, our proof combines a multilinear polynomial method, a continuity argument, and the topological Tverberg theorem.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对每个素数幂 $r\ge 2$，大小至少为 $(r-1)n+1$ 的 Sperner 族包含 $r$ 个两两不交的非空子族，其并全部相同且交全部相同。
AI.motivation: Sperner 定理是极值集合论的基础结果。Hegedüs 猜想了 $r=2$ 的情形（阈值为 $n+1$）。将平衡 Sperner 族与拓扑 Tverberg 定理联系起来是全新的视角。
AI.method: 组合了 multilinear polynomial method、连续性论证和 topological Tverberg theorem，将纯组合问题转化为拓扑框架下的不动点或分割问题。
AI.result: 对每个素数幂 $r\ge 2$，任何满足 $|\mathcal F|\ge (r-1)n+1$ 的 Sperner 族 $\mathcal F\subseteq 2^{[n]}$ 包含 $r$ 个两两不交的非空子族，其并集全部相等且交集全部相等。$r=2$ 的情形确认了 Hegedüs 猜想（阈值 $n+1$ 是紧的）。
AI.conclusion: 将拓扑方法（Tverberg 定理）巧妙应用于纯组合的 Sperner 族问题，揭示了极值集合论与拓扑组合学之间深层联系。
AI.future_work: 对非素数幂的 $r$ 是否成立类似的结论？探索更多拓扑方法在极值集合论中的应用。

title: Non-Isomorphic Optimal Cayley Graphs
summary: We present more than seventy optimal degree-diameter Cayley graphs that are non-isomorphic to previously known optimal Cayley graphs with the same degree and diameter. For each graph, we provide comprehensive data on its parameters and structural invariants. Comparison with known constructions reported by Marston Conder on the Combinatorics Wiki and in related works reveals significant differences in girth, algebraic connectivity, domination number, automorphism group structure, cycle distributions, distance-related properties, and other graph invariants. These findings show that optimal degree-diameter Cayley graphs are frequently non-unique. The new examples enlarge the catalogue of known optimal graphs and provide benchmarks for investigations in degree-diameter problems, algebraic graph theory, and extremal graph theory. Since some of the graphs were identified through randomized search techniques, the collection is not exhaustive.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了超过 70 个与已知最优图不同构的最优 degree-diameter Cayley 图，表明最优 degree-diameter Cayley 图经常不唯一。
AI.motivation: degree-diameter problem 是极值图论和网络设计中的核心问题。已知的最优 Cayley 图目录长期由少量构造主导，是否存在大量非同构的最优图尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用随机搜索技术发现新的最优 Cayley 图，并系统地比较其参数（girth、algebraic connectivity、domination number、自同构群结构、圈分布、距离性质等）与已知构造的差异。
AI.result: 展示了 70 多个与已知最优图不同构的最优 degree-diameter Cayley 图，在 girth、代数连通度、domination number、自同构群等结构不变量上有显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 最优 degree-diameter Cayley 图远非唯一，大大丰富了已知最优图的目录，为极值图论和代数图论提供了新的基准。
AI.future_work: 系统性搜索更大参数范围的最优 Cayley 图，研究是否存在无穷族非同构的最优 Cayley 图。

title: A general bound on $R(C_k,H)$
summary: In this paper, we prove that for every $k$ and every graph $H$ with $m$ edges and no isolated vertices, the Ramsey number $R(C_k,H)$ is at most $(k-1)m+1\le km$. This settles a problem of Erdős, Faudree, Rousseau and Schelp, which is listed as problem 34 in the graph theory collection.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对任意 $k$ 和任意有 $m$ 条边且无孤立点的图 $H$，Ramsey 数 $R(C_k,H)\le (k-1)m+1\le km$，解决了 Erdős 等人提出的问题。
AI.motivation: Ramsey 数 $R(C_k,H)$（圈对一般图的 Ramsey 数）的上界是一个经典问题。Erdős, Faudree, Rousseau 和 Schelp 提出并收录为图论问题集中的第 34 号问题。
AI.method: 通过构造性论证和对图 $H$ 边数的估计，结合极值图论中关于圈存在性的经典结果。
AI.result: 证明了 $R(C_k,H)\le (k-1)m+1\le km$ 对所有 $k$ 和所有无孤立点且 $m$ 条边的图 $H$ 成立。
AI.conclusion: 解决了图论经典问题集中一个长期的公开问题，上界简洁且普遍适用。
AI.future_work: 研究该上界何时是紧的，或对特定 $H$ 族（如完全图、完全二分图）给出更精确的界。

title: A Proof of Nash-Williams' Conjecture
summary: A central open question in extremal design theory is Nash-Williams' Conjecture from 1970 that every triangle-divisible graph on $n$ vertices (for $n$ large enough) with minimum degree at least $0.75 n$ has a triangle decomposition. In this paper, we prove this conjecture in full. In 2016, Barber, Kühn, Lo, and Osthus proved that if the fractional relaxation of Nash-Williams' Conjecture holds for minimum degree $cn$ for some constant $c\ge 0.75$, then Nash-Williams' Conjecture holds for any constant $c' > c$. The previously best-known bound on the fractional relaxation was due to Delcourt and Postle from 2021 with $c= \frac{7+\sqrt{21}}{14} \approx 0.82733$. This bound on the fractional relaxation has grown in importance over the years as it has been directly tied to bounds for a number of other problems in extremal design theory. This paper consists of three parts. In Part I, our first main result is a proof of the Fractional Nash-Williams' Conjecture: if $G$ is a graph on $n$ vertices with minimum degree at least $\frac{3n}{4}$, then $G$ has a fractional triangle decomposition. In Part II, our second main result is a Fractional Stability Theorem for Nash-Williams' Conjecture: if a graph $G$ on $n$ vertices has minimum degree close to $\frac{3n}{4}$ but no fractional $K_3$-decomposition, then $G$ is close (in edit distance) to the join of two $\frac{n}{4}$-regular graphs each on $\frac{n}{2}$ vertices. We use this to prove that if a triangle-divisible graph $G$ on $n$ vertices has minimum degree close to $\frac{3n}{4}$ but no $K_3$-decomposition, then $G$ is close (in edit distance) to the join of two $\frac{n}{4}$-regular graphs each on $\frac{n}{2}$ vertices. In Part III, our final main result is a proof of Nash-Williams' Conjecture in full.

AI.tldr: 本文完整证明了 Nash-Williams 猜想（1970）：每个充分大的 $n$ 顶点三角形可分的图，若最小度至少为 $0.75n$，则具有三角形分解。
AI.motivation: Nash-Williams 猜想是极值设计理论（extremal design theory）中 50 多年的核心公开问题，关于最小度条件下三角分解的存在性。该猜想与许多其他极值设计问题直接相关。
AI.method: 分三部分：Part I 证明 Fractional Nash-Williams 猜想（最小度 $\ge 3n/4$ 蕴含分数三角分解）；Part II 证明稳定性定理（无分数 $K_3$-分解的近极值图在编辑距离意义下接近两个 $n/4$-正则图的 join）；Part III 从分数分解和稳定性定理推导完整猜想。
AI.result: 完整证明了 Nash-Williams 猜想：最小度 $\ge 3n/4$ 蕴含三角分解。证明首先将分数分解的阈值从约 $0.82733n$ 降低到紧界 $0.75n$，再通过稳定性分析排除近极值反例。
AI.conclusion: 解决了极值设计理论中最重要的公开问题之一，标志着 triangle decomposition 问题的重大突破。分数分解阈值 $3/4$ 是紧的（两个 $n/4$-正则图的 join 恰好是最小度 $3n/4-1$ 的反例）。
AI.future_work: 将 Nash-Williams 猜想的证明框架推广到其他图的分解问题（如 $K_4$-分解、$C_k$-分解）。
